capture: manual macOS screen recording of the installed PR Cockpit app

crop.note: one fixed crop preserves the complete recording with equal source-pixel padding between the app window and every crop edge

trim.note: tightens the wallpaper margin around the app window to 24px left and right and drops the white band along the top edge

encode.note: re-encoded from the 1280x986 h264 master to apply the trim; crf lowered so the second generation does not add visible loss

poster.scene: search palette before typing at 0.5 seconds

paletteImage.scene: standalone Electron palette with word query over the desktop
